chunks.arabic_text: كَمَالُ الدِّينِ: أَحْمَدُ بْنُ زِيَادِ بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ الْهَمْدَانِيُّ، عَنْ عَلِيِّ بْنِ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ هَاشِمٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ، عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ الْهَمْدَانِيِّ قَالَ

translations.en: Kamal al-Din: Ahmad ibn Ziyad ibn Ja'far al-Hamdani, from Ali ibn Ibrahim ibn Hashim, from Muhammad ibn Isa ibn Ubayd, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad al-Hamdani who said:

chunks.arabic_text: قُلْتُ لِلرِّضَا عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامِ: يَا ابْنَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ أَخْبِرْنِي عَنْ زُرَارَةَ هَلْ كَانَ يَعْرِفُ حَقَّ أَبِيكَ؟ فَقَالَ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: نَعَمْ، فَقُلْتُ لَهُ: فَلِمَ بَعَثَ ابْنُهُ عُبَيْدًا لِيَتَعَرَّفَ الْخَبَرَ إِلَى مَنْ أَوْصَى الصَّادِقُ جَعْفَرُ بْنُ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ؟ فَقَالَ: إِنَّ زُرَارَةً كَانَ يَعْرِفُ أَمَرَ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، وَنَصَّ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ، وَإِنَّمَا بَعَثَ ابْنَهُ لِيَتَعَرَّفَ مِنْ أَبِيهِ هَلْ يَجُوزُ لَهُ أَنْ يَرْفَعَ التَّقِيَّةَ فِي إِظْهَارِ أَمْرِهِ، وَنَصَّ أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ؟ وَأَنَّهُ لَمَّا أَبْطَأَ عَنْهُ طُلِبَ إِظْهَارُ قَوْلِهِ فِي أَبِيهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ، فَلَمْ يُحِبْ أَنْ يَقْدَمَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ دُونَ أَمْرِهِ، فَرَفَعَ الْمُصْحَفَ وَقَالَ: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّ إِمَامِي مَنْ أَثْبَتَ هَذَا الْمُصْحَفَ إِمَامَتَهُ مِنْ وَلَدِ جَعْفَرِ بْنِ مُحَمَّدٍ عَلَيْهِمَا السَّلَامُ

translations.en: I said to al-Rida (peace be upon him): O son of the Messenger of Allah, inform me about Zurara, did he know the right of your father? He (peace be upon him) said: Yes. I said to him: Then why did his son Ubayd send to investigate the news regarding whom al-Sadiq Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them) designated? He said: Indeed, Zurara knew the affair of my father (peace be upon him), and the designation of his father to him. He only sent his son to know from my father whether it was permitted for him to lift the Taqiyya in manifesting his affair, and the designation of his father to him? And when he delayed, he was asked to manifest his opinion regarding my father (peace be upon him), so he did not like to proceed in doing so without his instruction, so he raised the Mushaf and said: O Allah, indeed my Imam is the one whose Imama this Mushaf establishes among the offspring of Ja'far ibn Muhammad (peace be upon them).

en.summary: This narration from *Kamal al-Din* highlights the nuanced practice of *Taqiyya* among the Four Companions, specifically illustrating how Zurara ibn A'yan, despite his deep knowledge of Imam al-Kadim's designation, awaited explicit permission to publicly reveal the Imamate. The account underscores the scholarly principle that public declaration of the Imam was not automatic but contingent upon the Imam's directive, a key concept in Shia jurisprudence regarding the transition from concealment to manifestation. Zurara's act of raising the Quran serves as a solemn, tangible witness to the divine authority of the Ahl al-Bayt.
en.seo_question: Why did Zurara send his son to ask about lifting Taqiyya before announcing Imam al-Kadim's Imamate?

key_terms.زُرَارَة: Zurara, a prominent companion of the Imams
key_terms.التَّقِيَّة: Taqiyya, the practice of dissimulation or concealment of belief
